OFFSITEPARKINGRESTRICTIVEDECLARATION Jamaica Building B LLC, having an address at 31 Spencer Street, 11h Floor, Brooklyn NY 11205 (hereinafter, the “Declarant-1") and Vaja Jamaica Building A LLC, having an address at 31 Spencer Street, 11h Floor, Brooklyn NY 11205 (hereinafter, the “Declarant-2"). Declarant-1 and WHEREAS, the Declarant-1 is the fee owner of certain land located in the City and State of New York, Borough of Queens, designated as Block 9761, Lot 30 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, also known as 89-25 162nd Street, hereinafter referred to as Declarant-1 Parcel, more particularly described by metes and bounds descriptions set forth in Schedule A annexed hereto and by this reference made a part hereof; WHEREAS,the Declarant-2 is thefee owner of certain land located in the City and State of New York, Borough of Queens, designated as Block 9760, Lot 50 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, also known as 89-26 162nd Street, hereinafter referred to as Declarant-2 Parcel, more particularly described by metes and bounds description set forth in Schedule B annexed hereto and by this reference made a part hereof; WHEREAS, Declarant-1 is desirous of creating a permanent easement for the purpose of permitting and enabling present and future owners, residents and invitees of Declarant-2 Parcel, their heirs, successors and assigns to pass over and utilize portions of Parcel designated as the "Parking Easement Area", substantially as shown on the diagram annexed hereto as Schedule C, for the purpose of ingress and egress to a proposed off-street accessory parking facility to be located on Declarant-1 Parcel, and (2) to utilize the thirty-four (34) parking spaces located in the Parking Easement Area, as shown on the diagram annexed hereto as Schedule C, on Declarant-1 Parcel to accommodate required parking for the uses on Declarant-2 Parcel, WHEREAS, the DOB requires the execution and recording of this Declaration in connection with the use of the Parking Easement Area as accessory off-site parking for the New Building pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork (as amended). NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the issuance by the DOB of a building permit for the New Building, the Declarants hereby declare as follows: 1. Declarant-1 hereby covenants and agrees for itself, its successors and assigns that the Parking Easement Area shall be used to permit and enable present and future owners, residents and invitees of Declarant-2 Parcel, their heirs, successors and assigns to pass over and utilize the Parking Easement Area for the purpose of ingress and egress to the proposed off-street accessory parking located on Declarant-1 Parcel; 2. Declarant-1 hereby covenants and agrees for itself, its successors and assigns that Thirty- Four (34) spaces, as required for the New Building at the time of the issuance of a building permit thereof, shall be reserved in the Parking Easement Area as accessory parking spaces to theNewBuildinglocatedonDeclarant-2Parcel;

3. Declarant-2 shall be permitted to incorporate the use of parking “"stackers" to provide the required 34 spaces. 4. The Parking Easement Area shall at all times be maintained and kept clear and unobstructed to allow utilization of the required parking spaces; 5. This Declaration may not be modified, amended or terminated without prior written consentofDOB; 6.The covenants set forth herein shall run with the land and be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective heirs, legal representatives, successors and assigns; 7. Failure to comply with the terms of this Declaration may result in the revocation of a building permit or certificate of occupancy; 8. This Declaration may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which when so executed and delivered shall be deemed an original, but all of which taken together shall be construed as and shall constitute but one and the same instrument. 9.This Declaration constitutes the entire agreement between the Declarants pertaining to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements and understandings of the Declarants in connection herewith. 10. This Declaration may not be modified, amended or terminated except by an instrument in writing signed by the Declarants hereto, or their successors and assigns. 11. This Declaration is intended to supersede and replace in the entirety, all covenants, easements and agreements that pertain to the parking located on Declarant-1Parcel and Declarant-2 Parcel, whether contained in deeds or independent document; and 12. This Declaration shall be recorded at the Queens County office of the City Register's office and the cross-reference number and title of the Declaration shall be cited on each temporary and permanent certificate of occupancy hereafter issued to Parcels A and B.
